description: This file defines a report parser class for generating a central journal report in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including methods for retrieving journal lines and summing debit/credit amounts.

classes.name: journal_print
classes.description: A report parser class for generating journal report data, including methods for retrieving journal lines and calculating sums.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser with context and updates local context with helper functions.

methods.name: lines
methods.description: Retrieves journal lines for given periods and journals, aggregating debit and credit sums.

methods.name: _sum_debit
methods.description: Calculates total debit amount for a given period and journal.

methods.name: _sum_credit
methods.description: Calculates total credit amount for a given period and journal.
